scope: FIRE Business App isolated candidates only
behavior: Payments checks both HTTP response statuses and requires both collections before replacing records.
Caught network/JSON/server failures display an accessible error with Retry.
Financial metrics, fee report and record/refund controls are hidden while loading or after a failed read; valid empty responses still show zero/empty state.
Existing state is preserved on failed refresh; retry calls both GET endpoints and recovers. Financial calculations and write handlers unchanged.
testLimits: Actual Payments component/hooks/effect/retry handler with mocked GET responses; existing payment-status suite uses synthetic SQLite. No hosted/mobile/Stripe integration evidence.
